channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Protests Outside Jammu Lok Bhavan Over MBBS Admissions; Effigy of LG Manoj Sinha Burnt Amid Non-Local Bias Allegations
item.description: Dozens of locals protested outside Jammu's Lok Bhavan on December 27, burning an effigy of Lt Governor Manoj Sinha to demand cancellation of the allegedly irregular MBBS admission list at Reasi's Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Institute.

item.title: Australia Issues Warning Over Counterfeit Rabies Vaccine In India; Manufacturer Refutes Charges
item.description: Australia has warned travellers about fake rabies vaccines in India, while manufacturer IIL refutes the "over-cautionary" advisory.

item.title: From Age-Group Cricket To IPL Glory, Vaibhav Suryavanshi Wins Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar
item.description: Recognised by President Droupadi Murmu, Vaibhav Suryavanshi’s Bal Puraskar honour celebrates discipline, records and India’s growing faith in youth talent.

item.title: Ernakulam Express Fire in Andhra Pradesh Reportedly Claims 1 Life, Sparks Panic and Renews Rail Safety Concerns
item.description: A fire in an AC coach of the Ernakulam Express spread rapidly through multiple compartments in Andhra Pradesh, killing one passenger, injuring several others, and prompting a high-level railway inquiry.

item.title: Baghpat Khap’s Smartphone and Half Pants Ban for Kids Ignites Clash Between Tradition and Tech
item.description: Baghpat khap bans minors' smartphones, half pants in public to uphold culture, curb distractions.

item.title: Bihar Goods Train Derailment Snarls Howrah Main Line, Dozens of Passenger Trains Hit; No Casualties Reported
item.description: A cement goods train derailment between Lahabon and Simultala stations disrupted the Howrah-Patna-Delhi rail route, cancelling 23 trains with no casualties but hours of passenger delays.

item.title: BJP Councillor’s Husband Arrested in Satna for 6-Month Knife Molestation, Threats Under BJP Rule Exposed
item.description: BJP councillor's husband jailed for knife-point molestation, blackmail, and boasting impunity in Satna.

item.title: People of Purpose: How CFTI’s ‘Cup of Care’ Is Transforming Menstrual Health in Rural India
item.description: CFTI's "Cup of Care" shatters menstrual taboos in rural Maharashtra through women-led awareness and cups.

item.title: Bengaluru Pre-Dawn Demolition Drive: Dozens Displaced, Political Storm Erupts Over Legality and Humanity
item.description: A pre-dawn demolition drive in Bengaluru displaces dozens of migrant families, fueling debates on timing, legality, and humanity amid rehabilitation promises.

item.title: Burned Alive in Bangladesh, Heckled in London: Hindus Fight for Justice After Dipu Chandra Das Lynching
item.description: Hindus rally outside Bangladesh High Commission in London for lynched Dipu Das justice, clash with Khalistanis amid 10 arrests.
